attempts.summary: Set up a nightly SSH+tar based backup of /srv/inventory/data (node2) to dated tar.gz archives in /var/backups/inventory (node1), scheduled via cron at 02:00 daily with 7-day retention pruning. Verified retention logic with simulated dated files, then restarted both node1 and node2 one at a time via systemctl reboot, confirming a changed boot_id on each and full recovery of cron, SSH connectivity, and a working end-to-end backup afterward.
